title: Drow Poison

sources.title: Coatings
markers: | description = A subset of Potions, Coatings can apply a variety of harmful effects to weapons that aid in combat for a short period of time.

summary: Coat weapons or throw a cloud to make targets Poisoned and Asleep on a failed DC 13 Constitution save.

fields.Coat: Bonus Action. Consume one dose to coat the active weapon set for 10 turns, including both weapons while dual wielding. Apply another dose for the other set. A hit forces DC 13 Constitution against Poisoned and Sleeping. A successful initial save grants inoculation for 2 turns. The effects end after a successful Constitution save or when the target takes damage.
fields.Throw: Action. Consume one dose to create a 3 ft-radius cloud for 1 turn. Each turn, creatures inside make a DC 13 Constitution save against Poisoned and Sleeping. The cloud deals no damage. The Poisoned and Sleeping effects end after a successful Constitution save or when the target takes damage.
fields.Crafting: Combine Essence of Swarming Toadstool with any Salt.
fields.Limits: Only one coating or dip can be active on a weapon set.
fields.Base value: 30 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Verified card mechanics against the cited item or linked rule.
